svg.text: gates a / b of the output devices; vfb = the pad
sg13cmos5l_IOPadDiff2Single: differential in, single-ended out, class-AB, pad - vref = (vinp - vinn) / 2
Custom padframe cell (case (a)): OP / ON are the pad's ESD clamp frames (d2s_out_p, d2s_out_n). Everything runs on the ring rails iovdd / iovss;
the 1.2 V core ring vdd is not connected inside the cell; vss joins iovss through the p-substrate (Rsub). vfb is tied to the pad (Kelvin line from the pad junction).
Slot fallback: iovdd = vdd_3v3, iovss = vss_3v3, vdd = vdd_1v2, vss = vss_1v2, pad = s7_an[1]. Netlist reference: ../../netlist/source/sg13cmos5l_IOPadDiff2Single.spice
Backannotated 2026-11-03 to the drawn cell (C2, layout/klayout, reference netlist pad_candidate.cdl): the cell holds Xd + Xt as drawn; en_ctrl_3v3 (en_3v3, en_3v3_b)
and bias_gen_pd (iref) sit next to it (slot, top level, CACE templates). CMA / CMB in v8 polarity, each behind its own 2 kOhm stage [S].
vdd: n.c.; vss: tied to iovss by Rsub (the p-substrate)
[O] output stage: d2s_out_p = the P clamp frame (OP, replica RP1, dummy RPD), d2s_out_n = the two N clamp frames (ON, replica RN1);
Miller capacitors CMA (gate a; S, D, well on pa) and CMB (gate on pb; S, D, well on b), hv PMOS 7.96u x 32.16u as drawn (v8 polarity)
[S] 2 kOhm secondary stages d2s_sp2k (rppd 1u x 7.435u, dantenna, dpantenna), pad -> pa and pad -> pb
[P] IHP primary diodes DCPDiode / DCNDiode as drawn: 2 stripes 1.26u x 65.8u / 67.6u each (IHP's cell: 27.78u)
Rsub: vss and iovss share the p-substrate. The vss band p+ tie (edge contract, as in IOPadAnalog) and the iovss ties sit in one
substrate, so LVS with --disable_tap_extraction (sak-lvs.sh) and magic see one net (Christoph, 2026-11-03: 2(a)).
Simulation: 1 Ohm, a stand-in for the substrate path. LVS netlists (lvs_ignore=1): left out (open). A SPICE subckt cannot
join two ports, and xschem refuses to short two port nets (Error 10). The layout has no top vss text, so both LVS see iovss.
